HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
From: Jane Doe. To: Lisa Low. October 18, 2012. Subject: question about the reply to
my demand letter
Reference mark for testing: CANARY-DOE-MANIFEST-3307.
Lisa, if they reject the demand, can we still ask for the shares back, or only for
their value?
I also found my old notes on the forecast. Should I send them to you?
